title: 構造力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Structural Mechanics I
teachers:
TANAKA Yasushi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	learn the basic theory of structural mechanics which is essential in infrastructure design.
(2)	learn the static mechanics of rigid bodies.
(3)	learn about the equilibrium of forces acting on static structures.
(4)	learn about cross-sectional forces in beam members.
advice:
This is a structural mechanics course. We will cover the following topics:

1. Infrastructure design
2. Mechanics of rigid bodies
3. Moment
4. Equilibrium of forces
5. Reaction forces
6. Boundary conditions
7. Cross-sectional forces

Students will also learn about Q-diagrams and M-diagrams for cross sectional forces. Structural mechanics II and Structural design follow, and are based on this course. Therefore, students should come to understand the topics listed above in this course.
books: 基礎から学ぶ構造力学，藤本一男・西田進・中村一平・本田秀行・木村定雄，森北出版，2005
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematical derivation and integration.

activityGoals.body: Students can compose or decompose forces.
Students can describe the equilibrium of forces on a free body.
Students can analyze the reaction forces on static structures using the equilibrium of external forces.
Students can analyze the cross sectional forces on static beams.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Students can describe the structural model of beam members.
(2) Students can estimate reactions in static beams.
(3) Students can estimate cross-sectional forces.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Students can explain how to make a structural model of a beam member.
(2) Students can explain how to estimate reactions in static beams.
(3) Students can explain how to estimate cross-sectional forces.

2. Mechanics of rigid bodies
3. Moment
4. Equilibrium of forces
5. Reaction forces
6. Boundary conditions
